docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Forty folk tales of the Panjab collected by Flora Annie Steel, with notes by R. C. Temple and drawings by Lockwood Kipling: Rāja Rasālu, the clever jackal, fairy and ghost stories.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Tales of the Punjab told by the people · Steel, Flora Annie Webster, 1847-1929 · 1894, 424 scanned pages. Published 1894; Flora Annie Steel died 1929, her annotator R. C. Temple 1931 and the illustrator John Lockwood Kipling 1911; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
